distribution.summary: 福建；广西；贵州；湖北；湖南；陕西；山西；四川；西藏；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) provides historical records from Fujian, Shaanxi, Sichuan and Xizang under Xyleborus emarginatus. Smith et al. (2020) directly treats Debus emarginatus and records Fujian, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hubei, Hunan, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Sichuan, Xizang, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan and reports only coarse China (WP) mainland wording, which is not converted to provinces.

host_note: The 殷蕙芬等 (1984) host set remains the promoted host evidence. Smith et al. (2020) adds no host in the promoted record. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous, but this broad wording is retained as context and does not add host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Debus emarginatus (Eichhoff, 1878).

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Xyleborus emarginatus; Smith et al. (2020) treats the current species as Debus emarginatus. Beaver & Liu (2010) records Taiwan material historically identified as Xyleborus exesus and reinstates that synonymy under Debus emarginatus. Canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Eichhoff, 1878).
